answer: Users can reset their password from the login page by selecting Forgot password. A reset link is valid for 15 minutes. If a user requests multiple reset emails, only the latest link remains valid.
If a user loses access to their authenticator app, they must complete identity verification before 2FA can be removed. Support cannot bypass identity verification.
Public API requests are limited to 120 requests per minute per token. When the rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429. Clients should implement exponential backoff and retry with jitter.
Webhook events are delivered at least once.
